headline: Milan Fashion Week wraps with strong buyer turnout from Korea and the Gulf

content.text:
Milan Fashion Week closed on Monday after six days of shows, with organisers reporting buyer registrations up 9 percent on last September, led by South Korea, Japan and the Gulf states. Attendance from mainland China rose but remains below pre-pandemic levels.

Retailers in the Montenapoleone district said traffic was busy through the week, helped by private client events and late opening hours. Hotels in the city centre were close to full from Sept 20.

Attention now moves to Paris, where the womenswear schedule runs from Sept 29 to Oct 7.
